summary: Annotated tests meaningfully prove all runner-only session-I/O operations—pending-input polling, delivery settlement, and transcript publication—require the master write principal plus an explicit runner identifier matching the task’s current owner. They cover successful authorized access and negative boundaries including anonymous, read-only, task-scoped, forged, omitted-runner, wrong-runner, and former-owner attempts, while worker tests verify explicit runner identity and ownership gating.
